Application Security

ضبط تقنين الإدخال

Processes that convert various possible input formats to a standard, canonical form before validation, helping to prevent injection or encoding-based attacks.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK and published by Protermify Cybersecurity as a static cybersecurity reference page.

Definition

Processes that convert various possible input formats to a standard, canonical form before validation, helping to prevent injection or encoding-based attacks.

Operational example

Apply Input Canonicalization Control to standardize all input before validation, mitigating risks from obfuscated or encoded payloads.
